title: Workflow (workflows/<workflow>/workflow.yaml)
description: Everything needed to manage one kind of thing from start to end, with one version for all of it. See docs/workflows.md.

version.description: M.m, quoted: a new major (M) is a breaking change, a new minor (m) is not. Guests and services name @M (newest M.x) or @M.m (exactly).

manages.description: vm or container: a guest of that type names it, and its first stage creates the machine, a VM or a Proxmox container. service: a service on a guest names it.

inputs.description: A JSON Schema inside this workflow's folder. For manages: vm or container it validates { hardware, network, inputs } from the guest, for manages: service { inputs } from the service.

ui.description: Hints for the form rendered from the inputs schema. Octopushy stores and serves them, and does not interpret them.

secrets.description: The extra vars a guest or service must provide in secrets or secretFiles. Only Ansible stages receive them.

stages.description: manages: vm and container have the OpenTofu stage that makes the machine, then at most one Ansible stage that sets it up. manages: service has one or more stages, planned and previewed, approved once, then applied in order.

actions.description: What else can be run from an Ansible stage, by name: by hand or on a guest's schedules. manages: vm or container only.

stage.description: The Ansible stage whose project, image and connection the action uses.

prepare.description: A playbook run on the agent before approval, with no secrets and no access to the guest. What it writes to OCTOPUSHY_PREPARED_FILE becomes extra vars. Relative to the stage's root.

snapshot.description: applied reuses what the guest's last successful run prepared.

destructive.description: Whether this action can delete data or a service. Octopushy cannot tell from a playbook, so this is required, and true waits under policy.destructive: manual.

approval.description: The approval this action takes on every guest, whatever the guest's own approval says. A guest's policy.actions overrides it. Destructive still applies.

outcomes.description: Results a playbook may report with set_stats, other than success or failure.

approve.description: A person may approve running the playbook once more with these extra vars. Not in manages: service, which has one approval.

result.description: How the run ends without an approval.

root.description: The OpenTofu root module or Ansible project, relative to this file. It must be inside this workflow's folder or under modules/.

image.description: Overrides the server's default image for the executor. Ignored by an agent with the local tool runtime.

verify.description: OpenTofu, the stage that makes a VM or container only: proxmox (the default) checks the machine through the Proxmox API afterwards.

hostKey.description: OpenTofu, the stage that makes a VM only, never a container's. managed: its module installs the SSH host key Octopushy generates for each guest, given as the sensitive variable octopushy_host_key, in a cloud-init snippet it uploads where octopushy_snippets says. A guest on an installation whose snippets.hosts lists its host then needs no access.hostKey. See docs/guest-configuration.md.

playbook.description: Ansible: what runs when the guest, the service or this workflow changes. Relative to root.

prepare.description: Ansible: a playbook run on the agent before approval, with no secrets and no access to the guest. Relative to root.

destructive.description: Ansible: whether the playbook can delete data or a service. False when not set.
